jobs.title: Fullstack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About This Vacancy

Als Fullstack Software Engineer werk je aan de volledige keten van softwareontwikkeling: van gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces tot robuuste backendlogica en cloudintegraties. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen verschillende technologieën en werkt samen met collega’s en klanten aan innovatieve oplossingen die impact maken. Denk aan:

Ontwerpen en bouwen van webapplicaties met moderne front-end frameworks (React, Angular, Vue).
Ontwikkelen van schaalbare backendservices in bijvoorbeeld Java, C#, Node.js of Python.
Integreren van databases, APIs en cloudservices (Azure, AWS, GCP).
Waarborgen van kwaliteit en performance via CI/CD, testautomatisering en DevOps-principes.
Samenwerken met UX-designers, data-engineers en domeinexperts om complete oplossingen te realiseren.

What We Expect From You

3 tot 8 jaar ervaring met fullstack softwareontwikkeling in hightech of enterprise-omgevingen.
Aantoonbare ervaring met zowel front-end (React, Angular of Vue) als back-end (Java, C#, Node.js, Python).
Een afgeronde Bachelor-, bij voorkeur Masteropleiding in een technisch vakgebied (bijvoorbeeld informatica, software engineering of wiskunde).
Kennis van en ervaring met softwaredesign en ontwikkelprincipes (OOP, TDD, SOLID, Clean Code).
Ervaring met cloudplatforms (Azure, AWS of GCP) en containertechnologie (Docker, Kubernetes) is een plus.
Ervaring met Scrum, Agile of SAFe methodieken.
Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.
Een analytische, pragmatische en gestructureerde manier van werken.

What You Can Expect From Us

Een arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd, zodat je stabiliteit hebt in een dynamische omgeving.
Een uitgebreide individuele winstdeling.
Een individueel opleidingsbudget van €2.200 per jaar, zodat je jezelf continu kunt blijven ontwikkelen.
De kans om samen te groeien met onze ervaren professionals in onze kleinschalige, hechte business-cel.
Toegang tot ons TMC Entrepreneurial Lab, waar je je eigen ideeën en projecten tot leven kunt brengen.
Een omgeving waar jouw stem telt en waar jouw dromen werkelijkheid kunnen worden.

Bij TMC werk je in een uniek model waarin ondernemerschap, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en technologische innovatie samenkomen. Jij bepaalt de koers, wij zorgen voor de support en de mogelijkheden.

jobs.title: MCP Expert (Java API Integration)
jobs.description:
MCP Expert (Java API Integration) Amsterdam

Hybrid | 12-Month Contract (Extendable) | Rate: Negotiable

Get in on the ground floor of enterprise AI integration.

Our client is building the platform that connects AI agents to real enterprise systems and they need an MCP expert who's already done this in production, not just in a proof of concept. This is a genuinely rare opportunity: MCP is brand new, production deployments are scarce, and this role puts you at the center of a Central Platform Team shaping how AI agents talk to Java-based enterprise APIs at scale.
If you've built MCP servers that actually run in production not just demos this is your next move.

The Role

You'll design, build and own the integration layer connecting AI agents and LLM-based applications to enterprise Java APIs via MCP. You'll work the full delivery lifecycle Dev, UAT, production on Azure, with real ownership and real influence over how the organization adopts MCP going forward.

What You'll Do

Design, build and maintain MCP servers and tool integrations exposing enterprise Java APIs to AI agents and LLM applications
Develop and integrate Java REST APIs within MCP-based architectures on the central platform
Own integrations across dev, UAT and production - robust, monitored, genuinely production-grade
Deploy and operate on Microsoft Azure (App Services, Functions, API Management, Azure Open AI / AI Foundry)
Partner with platform, architecture and product teams to define MCP standards and best practice across the organization
Take point on troubleshooting, production support and incident resolution
Shape documentation, testing strategy and release process from the ground up

What You Bring

Proven, hands-on MCP experience you've built MCP servers, tools and integrations, not just read the spec
Strong Java development background with real REST API design and integration experience
Solid Microsoft Azure experience deploying, configuring and running services in production
Comfort across the full dev UAT production lifecycle, including live support
Able to work from Amsterdam 2 days a week
Strong English communication skills

Nice to Have

Azure Open AI, Azure AI Foundry, or agentic AI framework experience
APIM, Docker/Kubernetes, CI/CD via Azure DevOps
Background on central platform or shared-services teams
Dutch language skills

What's On Offer

12-month contract with strong potential to extend
Rate fully negotiable bring your number
Hybrid working: just 2 days a week on-site in Amsterdam
A front-row seat at the center of the organization's AI and integration strategy the kind of role that looks very good on a CV in 12 months' time

Darwin Recruitment is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

jobs.description:
Rolle und Aufgaben

Entwicklung skalierbarer Softwarekomponenten mit C#, .NET und Java (idealerweise Java 21)
Umsetzung von Geschäftsanforderungen in wartbare, testbare Code-Lösungen
Mitwirkung an generativen KI-Lösungen und Integrationsschichten (APIs, Datenpipelines)

Identifizierung von Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten in der Leistung, Sicherheit und Wartbarkeit systemübergreifend sowie Unterstützung der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Engineering-Standards, -Methoden und -Tools

Profil und Qualifikationen

Hochschulabschluss in Informatik oder verwandtem Bereich und mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung
Fundierte Kenntnisse in C#, .NET, Java (idealerweise Java 21) und Datenbanken (z. B. SQL Server, Oracle DB)
Kenntnisse in REST-API, Git und Webtechnologien sind erforderlich
Erfahrung mit agilen Methoden und analytischen Problemlösungsfähigkeiten sowie Erfahrung oder Interesse an Input-Management-Lösungen (z. B. SmartFix, Paradatec AIDA/Prokey, OpenText Capture) sind von Vorteil
Sehr Gute Englischkenntnisse und gute Deutschkenntnisse von Vorteil

Angebot und Rahmenbedingungen

Eine spannende Aufgabe, in der Sie Ihr Expertenwissen einbringen können

Wachsen Sie mit uns gemeinsam! Wir bieten Raum, um füreinander und miteinander die Zukunft von ERGO zu gestalten. Da Sie zur erfolgreichen Entwicklung von ERGO beitragen, können Sie von uns als Arbeitgeber einiges erwarten, zum Beispiel flexible Arbeitszeiten, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Möglichkeiten zur Entwicklung, eine faire Vergütung und sogar gratis Heißgetränke und Wasser. Mobiles Arbeiten ist bis zu 50 Prozent der monatlichen Arbeitszeit möglich und bietet Ihnen ein hohes Maß an Flexibilität. Wir bieten Ihnen die Unterstützung, die Sie benötigen, um Ihr volles Potential zu entfalten sowie Ihre Arbeit und Ihr Privatleben passend vereinbaren zu können. Wir kümmern uns um Sie!

Über uns

Die ERGO Direkt AG ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der ERGO Group AG und gehört damit zu einer der führenden internationalen Versicherungsgruppen. Bei uns erwarten Sie ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld, vielfältige Entwicklungschancen und verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben, an denen Sie persönlich und fachlich wachsen können. Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Versicherung neu – mit einem gemeinsamen Ziel: Menschen zu helfen, ihr Leben mutiger und besser zu gestalten.

Gemeinsam wachsen

Bei ERGO Direkt erleben Sie gelebte Vielfalt und haben die Chance, mit Menschen aus verschiedenen Ländern und Fachbereichen zusammenzuarbeiten. Ihren Entwicklungsweg gestalten Sie selbst – mit Seminaren, Programmen, Netzwerkformaten, Sprachkursen, E‑Learnings und Lernen im Job. Unsere starken nationalen und internationalen Strukturen eröffnen Ihnen dafür vielfältige und flexible Karrierewege.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

Division: Group Business Solutions (GBS)

As a Senior .NET Software Engineer within Group Business Solutions (GBS), you will play a key role in designing, building, and evolving business-critical applications that support Euroclear's operations and strategic initiatives. You will combine deep technical expertise with application ownership, working closely with business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, and resilient solutions. Beyond software development, you will drive modernization efforts, promote engineering excellence, and help ensure the long-term sustainability and reliability of the application landscape.

Key Responsibilities

Carry out the end-to-end design and the build of enterprise-grade .NET solutions, defining technical specifications ensuring scalability, resilience, security, and maintainability across the application landscape.
Drive requirements analysis, solution estimation, technical feasibility assessments, and risk identification to enable predictable delivery of complex initiatives and strategic programs.
Align with business stakeholders, architects, and product teams to build and ship solutions, help identify modernization opportunities(e.g. cloud migration), and maximize business value through technology-driven enhancements.
Champion production reliability and support stability by leading root-cause analysis, implementing permanent corrective actions, and following proactive monitoring and observability practices.
Create and govern high-quality solution designs and following strict Euroclear methodology by creating technical documentation, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards, security requirements, and long-term technology roadmaps.
As an application owner, own the application roadmap and long-term sustainability, Ensure applications continue to meet business requirements.
Review and approve application changes and enhancements, Support design decisions and future evolution of the application
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineering teams, promoting engineering excellence, best practices, and continuous improvement.

What You Need To Have For This Role

Extensive hands-on experience designing, developing, and supporting large-scale distributed applications and enterprise-grade software solutions using Microsoft technologies.
Deep expertise in software architecture, design patterns, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and cloud-native application development.
Strong experience with:
Visual Studio, Git, GitHub, and Azure DevOps
CI/CD pipelines and DevOps automation
Microsoft Azure services
Microsoft SQL Server and performance diagnostics tools
REST APIs, integration patterns, and IBM MQ
PowerApps
GitHub Copilot and AI-assisted software development

Advanced Proficiency In

C#, .NET, and ASP.NET Core
REST APIs and Integration Patterns
Microsoft SQL Server
Microsoft PowerApps
Cloud and Hybrid Integration Solutions
Designing scalable, secure, resilient, and high-performing applications
DevOps practices, CI/CD automation, observability, monitoring, performance tuning, release management, and production support
Software quality engineering practices including automated testing, code reviews, static code analysis, security scanning, and continuous improvement
Application modernization and cloud migration strategies

About Us

Why join us

Embark on your new adventure at Euroclear, and work at the heart of the global capital markets. We connect over 2,000 financial institutions across the globe. As an open and resilient infrastructure, we contribute to the stability of the financial markets. We help clients cut through complexity, lower costs, and mitigate risks of financial transactions. At Euroclear, we have the clear ambition to use our key role to facilitate and accelerate a sustainable global financial system.

What We Offer

Work closely with inspiring, supportive and engaged colleagues from more than 80 different countries.
Practice your talents in a highly professional international environment.
Join a learning and development environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing and training.
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits.

Ways of working

Find your own optimal balance within our hybrid working model, where you can connect at the office 8 days a month and also benefit from remote working.

Great Place to Work for All

We are committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates diversity and strives to be a Great Place to Work for All. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment, regardless of any aspect that makes them unique (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy, disability, ...). If you need any specific accommodation due to disability or any other reason, you can let the recruiter know during your application process. Our values guide how we work together and shape our future: Our mission and values - Euroclear

About The Team

The Group Business Solutions (GBS) division ensures the competitiveness of Euroclear by delivering reliable and sustainable IT solutions for the financial securities markets. Our technical teams deliver new IT solutions and improve existing applications for both our internal and external clients. We deploy changes into the production environment in a controlled and structured way that doesn't compromise production stability and we ensure applicative production support.
